## `loadEnv`

**Type Signature:**

```ts
function loadEnv(
  mode: string,
  envDir: string,
  prefixes: string | string[] = 'VITE_',
): Record<string, string>
```

**Related:** [`.env` Files](./env-and-mode.md#env-files)

Load `.env` files within the `envDir` and merge them with the matching variables already present in `process.env`. By default, only env variables prefixed with `VITE_` are loaded, unless `prefixes` is changed.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).

a.quote: By default, only env variables prefixed with `VITE_` are loaded, unless `prefixes` is changed.

b.quote: They _are_ automatically loaded later and exposed to application code via `import.meta.env` (with the default `VITE_` prefix filter) exactly as documented in [Env Variables and Modes](/guide/env-and-mode.html).
